'''Odar''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], Odar was present in [[Oradam village|Oradam]] when the village was ransacked by [[Mantellian Trooper|Mantellian soldiers]] who stole his belongings and arrested his daughter, [[Qo'el]] for her suspected ties to the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]]. Odar didn't know why his possessions were seized nor why his daughter was taken, but he desperately wanted Qo'el returned to him. He asked a passing Republic spacer to search for [[Qo'el]] in [[Fort Garnik]]. The spacer released his daughter from imprisonment and returned her to Odar.<ref name="TOR" />
